claims.claim: The asset matches the requested guest chair identity, fixture type, dimensions and parts.
claims.evidence: asset/provenance.json instance_id is furniture/guest_chair_0; asset/asset.json and readings.json declare fixture. probes/02_geometry.out measures mesh size 0.60900005 x 0.54548526 x 0.86589351 m, matching the requested approximately 0.609 x 0.545 x 0.866 m. renders/front.png, side.png, top.png and iso.png show the seat, curved back, four legs and neutral finish.

claims.claim: Named collision boxes cover the visual chair while preserving access to the seat and the space between the legs.
claims.evidence: asset/model.urdf has 71 named boxes covering the segmented curved back, seat, four legs, nails and back ring. probes/02_geometry.out finds 0 uncovered mesh vertices out of 10919 and 0 uncovered face centroids out of 7554 (0.00001 m tolerance). The four renders agree with this arrangement. No box obstructs the tested seat approach column x=[0.06,0.10], y=[-0.02,0.02] above z=0.44680, or the central space below the seat. In probes/01_fixture.out, a 4 cm cube dropped at (0.08,0,0.60) rests at z=0.46676 after 150 frames, with four seat contacts totaling 0.980 N; a cube between the legs falls to ground at z=0.01997.

claims.claim: Joint travel, attachment and inter-link interference checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: readings.json joints is empty; asset/model.urdf contains one body link and no joints. probes/01_fixture.out reports joints {}. The request explicitly requires no joints.

claims.claim: Handle grasp and pull checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: readings.json handles is empty, as requested. The decorative back ring is not an annotated grasp handle.

claims.claim: Place-target settling checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: readings.json place_targets is empty, as requested. The optional seat cube test nevertheless confirms seat collision support in probes/01_fixture.out.

claims.claim: The chair is correctly used as a fixed floor fixture; free-body upright settling is not applicable.
claims.evidence: request.md and asset/asset.json specify fixture rather than a movable rigid object. probes/02_geometry.out gives the foot minimum z=-0.0003086 m, approximately floor level. probes/01_fixture.out retains body position [0,0,0] and identity rotation through 150 frames with fixed loading.
